title: 2288. Apply Discount to Prices

examples.input: sentence = "there are $1 $2 and 5$ candies in the shop", discount = 50
examples.output: "there are $0.50 $1.00 and 5$ candies in the shop"
examples.explanation: The words which represent prices are "$1" and "$2". - A 50% discount on "$1" yields "$0.50", so "$1" is replaced by "$0.50". - A 50% discount on "$2" yields "$1". Since we need to have exactly 2 decimal places after a price, we replace "$2" with "$1.00".
Applying a 100% discount on any price will result in 0. The words representing prices are "$3", "$5", "$6", and "$9". Each of them is replaced by "$0.00".
